title: No thought of music as a livelihood
summary: Asked what he wanted to be, he says he did not know; the piano was only a toy to him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Although I never thought of it as a livelihood or whatever, I can remember at the same time where my relatives, my uncles or aunts, would come around and they would always ask (there's five kids in the family and all of this) "What do you want to be when you grow up?" And my brother always had a ready answer. He'd say "a carpenter" or whatever came into his mind, and they were always admiring him, you know. They'd ask me, and I would say, "I don't know." And at the same time, I never had the connection of me playing the piano and making any money. That wasn't the idea at all! I just liked to play the piano like it was a toy or something.
